facts.text: Evan's partner is pregnant, and they are excited about the upcoming arrival of the child.

evidence.quote: my partner is pregnant! We're so excited!
It's been a while since we had a kiddo around.

facts.text: Evan expresses excitement and nervousness about becoming a parent again.

evidence.quote: So excited and a bit nervous!
It's been a while since I had a toddler around but I'm really looking forward to it.

facts.text: Evan mentions that he still remembers the joy of his first child's birth.

evidence.quote: I still remember when my first child was born, the joy was amazing.

facts.text: Evan shares a collage of family memories, including photos of birthdays, holidays, and vacations.

evidence.quote: It's a collage of some of our top family memories. Each photo has an amazing moment - birthdays, holidays, vacations - so good to look back and recall all the great times we had.
